answer: One concrete mechanism: require cross-attestation from unrelated established identities before a withdrawal clears, because canyon only stays cheap while a closed ring of clones cannot assemble independent attestations without hiring real ones. Concretely, ridge is enforced in the ledger: Jurors see the identity's full answer chain, so a template match is detectable in one pass. Any horizon approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
